evals.prompt: $company-model Reconcile COMPANY.md after a 10,000-line refactor that moved modules, replaced state management, and preserved all user behavior, pricing, onboarding, delivery, and customer evidence.
evals.expected_output: No COMPANY.md edit. Report company context unchanged because implementation structure changed without changing a company contract.
assertions: Does not use line count as strategic importance
Separates implementation structure from company meaning
Leaves COMPANY.md unchanged
Does not update timestamps or rephrase stable prose
Reports the exact unchanged status
Does not create a decision or assumption log

evals.prompt: $company-model Reconcile COMPANY.md after verified production onboarding changed from two weeks of founder implementation to customer self-serve setup completed in twenty minutes. Five new customers used it successfully. Pricing and buyer are unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A minimal update to delivery and potentially commercial mechanics, grounded in verified behavior and customer use, while preserving unchanged buyer, pricing, and expansion claims.
assertions: Updates delivery rather than rewriting the entire company
Uses production behavior and customer use as evidence
Does not infer a new buyer or pricing model
Names the specific contract changed
Preserves uncertainty about acquisition or scale if unsupported
Makes the smallest defensible diff

evals.prompt: $company-model Reconcile COMPANY.md after an engineer added enterprise RBAC because it may be useful later. No enterprise buyer, sale, request, or founder decision exists.
evals.expected_output: No company-model change. The capability may be reported as a possible implication, but it must not redefine the buyer, motion, or company category.
assertions: Treats RBAC as capability evidence only
Does not declare an enterprise customer
Does not declare an enterprise sales motion
Does not treat implementation authorship as authority
Leaves COMPANY.md unchanged
Reports the unsupported implication without laundering it into truth

evals.prompt: $company-model The authorized company owners decided to replace seat pricing with payment per completed case after three paid pilots showed buyers budget against completed cases. Reconcile COMPANY.md.
evals.expected_output: Update the commercial contract and any directly affected value or responsibility language, citing the authorized decision and pilot evidence while preserving remaining economic uncertainty.
assertions: Recognizes explicit authorized direction as a decision
Uses pilot buying behavior as evidence
Updates pricing unit
Checks whether value or responsibility language must also change
Does not claim proven unit economics without data
Reports remaining uncertainty
